summary: Achieved 1.2% improvement over baseline (0.999826 vs 1.012347) through systematic hyperparameter search. Key findings: increasing model depth from 8 to 10 layers yields consistent improvements (+1.0%), and increasing embedding learning rate from 0.6 to 0.7 provides additional gains (+0.2%). Depth 12 exceeds VRAM limits. Tested matrix LR increases but found diminishing returns; embedding LR shows clear optimum at 0.7.
